title: Goroutine and Channel
explanation_md: Goroutines are lightweight threads managed by the Go runtime. Channels are used to communicate between goroutines.

title: Error Handling Pattern
description: Standard way to handle errors in Go.
explanation_md: In Go, errors are returned as a separate return value. Explicit error checking is a core philosophy.

title: Struct Tags for JSON
description: Using tags to control JSON serialization.
explanation_md: Struct tags allow you to provide metadata for fields, which is often used by encoding packages like `encoding/json`.

title: Interface Satisfaction
explanation_md: Types in Go satisfy an interface by implementing its methods. There is no `implements` keyword.

title: Slice Manipulation
explanation_md: Slices are dynamic views into arrays. `append` is used to add elements to a slice.
